title: Mobilizing emergency support for impacted residents of Boyle Heights fire
description: Supervisor Hilda L. Solis in coordination with the Office of Emergency Management, LA County departments and other partners have mobilized to support East LA residents impacted by the Boyle Heights Storage Facility Fire. So far, teams have handed out more than 2,300 air purifiers, 10K N95 masks, and 1,500 boxes of food to local residents.
